extraction_report.paper_summary: LARIS is a method to infer spatially specific ligand-receptor interactions and sender→receiver cell-type communication from spatial transcriptomics. It combines k-NN spatial diffusion, cosine-similarity based spatial specificity scoring, COSG-based cell-type specificity, and permutation testing to produce LR spatial scores and cell-type-level interaction scores with p-values/FDR.
extraction_report.research_objective: Identify spatially localized LR interactions and infer sender→receiver cell-type interactions in spatial transcriptomics data, with statistical significance testing.
